args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
FROM trader t
JOIN (
    SELECT trdref
    FROM (
        SELECT trdref, trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' AS risk_level,
               trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio' AS levratio,
               (voldaily / acctbal) AS dtr
        FROM trader
    ) AS trader_risk
    WHERE (levratio::FLOAT > 5.0 AND risk_level = 'Aggressive')
       OR dtr > 0.5
) AS high_risk_traders ON t.tradereg = high_risk_traders.trdref
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
JOIN compliancecase cc ON tr.transreg = cc.transref
JOIN enforcementactions ea ON cc.compreg = ea.compref2
WHERE (ea.esclvl ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.acttake ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.resstat ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.penimp ILIKE '%significant%')
    AND cc.lastrevdt >= DATE '2023-05-25';

args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
FROM trader t
JOIN (
    SELECT tradereg
    FROM (
        SELECT tradereg, trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' AS risk_level,
               trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio' AS levratio,
               (voldaily / acctbal) AS dtr
        FROM trader
    ) AS trader_risk
    WHERE (levratio::FLOAT > 5.0 AND risk_level = 'Aggressive')
       OR dtr > 0.5
) AS high_risk_traders ON t.tradereg = high_risk_traders.tradereg
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
JOIN compliancecase cc ON tr.transreg = cc.transref
JOIN enforcementactions ea ON cc.compreg = ea.compref2
WHERE (ea.esclvl::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.acttake::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.resstat::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.penimp::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%')
    AND cc.lastrevdt >= DATE '2023-05-25';
